title: Influence of dominant sequence artifacts on generative AI for virtual contrast-enhancement in breast MRI.
summary: In 1,974 breast MRI examinations, excluding DWI artifact-affected slices during pix2pix virtual contrast training produced only a small SSIM increase and no material improvement in lesion-level or reader-rated outcomes; strong inference-time artifacts were associated with higher lesion error. This is a technical limitation/result, not improved clinical diagnosis.
ai_technology: Pix2pix GAN generates virtual contrast-enhanced breast MRI from noncontrast sequences.
